### `databases.queryRows`

Read a database's rows with values keyed by property name.

Select/status values come back as option names. `where` matches exact values (case-insensitive for text).

**Permission:** `databases.read` · **Returns:** `DatabaseRowInfo[]` · **Callers:** plugins, assistant · **Assistant modes:** Ask, Edit, Creator

| Param | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `databaseId` | `string` | yes | Database id. |
| `where` | `Record<string, unknown>` |  | Property name → value that must match. |
| `limit` | `number` |  | Maximum rows. Default `200`. |

```ts
const rows = await app.databases.queryRows({ databaseId, where: { Status: "Done" } });
```

### `databases.create`

Create a database with properties.

Property types: text, number, select, multiSelect, status, date, checkbox, url, email, phone, createdTime, lastEdited.

**Permission:** `databases.write` · **Returns:** `{ databaseId: string }` · **Callers:** plugins, assistant · **Assistant modes:** Edit, Creator

| Param | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `title` | `string` | yes | Database title. |
| `parentId` | `string` |  | Parent page/folder id. |
| `properties` | `{ /** Property name. */ name: string; /** Property type. */ type: "text" \| "number" \| "select" \| "multiSelect" \| "status" \| "date" \| "checkbox" \| "url" \| "email" \| "phone" \| "createdTime" \| "lastEdited"; /** Options for select / multiSelect / status. */ options?: string[]; }[]` |  | Columns besides the title. |
| `view` | `"table" \| "board" \| "gallery" \| "list" \| "calendar"` |  | First view type. Default `"table"`. |
| `open` | `boolean` |  | Open it in a tab. Default `true`. |

### `databases.addProperty`

Add a property (column) to a database.

**Permission:** `databases.write` · **Returns:** `{ propertyId: string }` · **Callers:** plugins, assistant · **Assistant modes:** Edit, Creator

| Param | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `databaseId` | `string` | yes | Database id. |
| `name` | `string` | yes | Property name. |
| `type` | `"text" \| "number" \| "select" \| "multiSelect" \| "status" \| "date" \| "checkbox" \| "url" \| "email" \| "phone" \| "createdTime" \| "lastEdited"` | yes | Property type. |
| `options` | `string[]` |  | Options for select / multiSelect / status. |

### `databases.addRow`

Add a row; values are keyed by property name.

Dates: ISO "2026-03-01". Selects: option name (created if missing). Multi-select: array of names. Checkbox: boolean.

**Permission:** `databases.write` · **Returns:** `{ rowId: string }` · **Callers:** plugins, assistant · **Assistant modes:** Edit, Creator

| Param | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `databaseId` | `string` | yes | Database id. |
| `title` | `string` |  | Row title. |
| `values` | `Record<string, unknown>` |  | Property name → value. |

### `databases.updateRow`

Change a row's title and/or values (keyed by property name).

**Permission:** `databases.write` · **Returns:** `void` · **Callers:** plugins, assistant · **Assistant modes:** Edit, Creator

| Param | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `rowId` | `string` | yes | Row (page) id. |
| `title` | `string` |  | New title. |
| `values` | `Record<string, unknown>` |  | Property name → value. null clears. |

### `databases.getView`

Get one view with its filters, sorts, grouping, visible properties and calculations.

**Permission:** `databases.read` · **Returns:** `DatabaseViewInfo` · **Callers:** plugins, assistant · **Assistant modes:** Ask, Edit, Creator

| Param | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `databaseId` | `string` | yes | Database id. |
| `viewId` | `string` |  | View id (defaults to the first view). |

### `databases.queryView`

Read rows the way a view shows them (its filters and sorts applied), optionally with a search.

**Permission:** `databases.read` · **Returns:** `DatabaseRowInfo[]` · **Callers:** plugins, assistant · **Assistant modes:** Ask, Edit, Creator

| Param | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `databaseId` | `string` | yes | Database id. |
| `viewId` | `string` |  | View id (defaults to the first view). |
| `search` | `string` |  | Text search across all properties. |
| `filters` | `{ /** Property name or id ("title" or the title column's name for the title). */ property: string; /** Operator. */ op: "contains" \| "notContains" \| "is" \| "isNot" \| "startsWith" \| "endsWith" \| "isEmpty" \| "isNotEmpty" \| "eq" \| "neq" \| "gt" \| "lt" \| "gte" \| "lte" \| "before" \| "after" \| "onOrBefore" \| "onOrAfter"; /** Value to compare with (omit for isEmpty / isNotEmpty). */ value?: unknown; }[]` |  | Filter rules (replaces the view's filters). Select/status/multi-select values are option names; dates are ISO. |
| `filterMode` | `"and" \| "or"` |  | and \| or for `filters`. |
| `sorts` | `{ /** Property name or id ("title" or the title column's name for the title). */ property: string; /** Direction. */ direction?: "asc" \| "desc"; }[]` |  | Sort rules, first wins (replaces the view's sorts). |
| `limit` | `number` |  | Maximum rows. Default `200`. |

```ts
const late = await app.databases.queryView({ databaseId, filters: [{ property: "Due", op: "before", value: "2026-01-01" }], sorts: [{ property: "Due" }] });
```

### `databases.addView`

Add a view (table, board, gallery, list or calendar) with optional filters, sorts and grouping.

**Permission:** `databases.write` · **Returns:** `DatabaseViewInfo` · **Callers:** plugins, assistant · **Assistant modes:** Edit, Creator

| Param | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `databaseId` | `string` | yes | Database id. |
| `name` | `string` |  | View name. |
| `type` | `"table" \| "board" \| "gallery" \| "list" \| "calendar"` |  | Layout. Default `"table"`. |
| `filters` | `{ /** Property name or id ("title" or the title column's name for the title). */ property: string; /** Operator. */ op: "contains" \| "notContains" \| "is" \| "isNot" \| "startsWith" \| "endsWith" \| "isEmpty" \| "isNotEmpty" \| "eq" \| "neq" \| "gt" \| "lt" \| "gte" \| "lte" \| "before" \| "after" \| "onOrBefore" \| "onOrAfter"; /** Value to compare with (omit for isEmpty / isNotEmpty). */ value?: unknown; }[]` |  | Filter rules (replaces the view's filters). Select/status/multi-select values are option names; dates are ISO. |
| `filterMode` | `"and" \| "or"` |  | Match all rules (and) or any (or). |
| `sorts` | `{ /** Property name or id ("title" or the title column's name for the title). */ property: string; /** Direction. */ direction?: "asc" \| "desc"; }[]` |  | Sort rules, first wins (replaces the view's sorts). |
| `groupBy` | `string` |  | Board/table grouping property (select, multi-select, status, checkbox). "" removes grouping. |
| `hiddenGroups` | `string[]` |  | Group values (option names) to hide on a board. |
| `show` | `string[]` |  | Properties to show, in order (others are hidden). |
| `hide` | `string[]` |  | Properties to hide. |
| `order` | `string[]` |  | Property order (names or ids). |
| `widths` | `Record<string, number>` |  | Property → column width in px (table). |
| `calcs` | `Record<string, "none" \| "countAll" \| "countValues" \| "countUnique" \| "countEmpty" \| "countNotEmpty" \| "percentEmpty" \| "percentNotEmpty" \| "checked" \| "unchecked" \| "percentChecked" \| "sum" \| "average" \| "median" \| "min" \| "max" \| "range" \| "earliest" \| "latest">` |  | Property → footer calculation (table). |
| `dateProperty` | `string` |  | Date property for calendar views. |
| `cardPreview` | `"cover" \| "none"` |  | Card preview for board/gallery. |
| `wrap` | `boolean` |  | Wrap long cell text. |

```ts
await app.databases.addView({ databaseId, type: "board", name: "By status", groupBy: "Status", filters: [{ property: "Done", op: "is", value: false }] });
```

### `databases.updateView`

Change a view: name, layout, filters, sorts, grouping, visible properties, order, widths, calculations.

Only the fields you pass change. `filters` and `sorts` replace the existing lists; pass [] to clear.

**Permission:** `databases.write` · **Returns:** `DatabaseViewInfo` · **Callers:** plugins, assistant · **Assistant modes:** Edit, Creator

| Param | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `databaseId` | `string` | yes | Database id. |
| `viewId` | `string` | yes | View id. |
| `name` | `string` |  | View name. |
| `type` | `"table" \| "board" \| "gallery" \| "list" \| "calendar"` |  | Layout. |
| `filters` | `{ /** Property name or id ("title" or the title column's name for the title). */ property: string; /** Operator. */ op: "contains" \| "notContains" \| "is" \| "isNot" \| "startsWith" \| "endsWith" \| "isEmpty" \| "isNotEmpty" \| "eq" \| "neq" \| "gt" \| "lt" \| "gte" \| "lte" \| "before" \| "after" \| "onOrBefore" \| "onOrAfter"; /** Value to compare with (omit for isEmpty / isNotEmpty). */ value?: unknown; }[]` |  | Filter rules (replaces the view's filters). Select/status/multi-select values are option names; dates are ISO. |
| `filterMode` | `"and" \| "or"` |  | Match all rules (and) or any (or). |
| `sorts` | `{ /** Property name or id ("title" or the title column's name for the title). */ property: string; /** Direction. */ direction?: "asc" \| "desc"; }[]` |  | Sort rules, first wins (replaces the view's sorts). |
| `groupBy` | `string` |  | Board/table grouping property (select, multi-select, status, checkbox). "" removes grouping. |
| `hiddenGroups` | `string[]` |  | Group values (option names) to hide on a board. |
| `show` | `string[]` |  | Properties to show, in order (others are hidden). |
| `hide` | `string[]` |  | Properties to hide. |
| `order` | `string[]` |  | Property order (names or ids). |
| `widths` | `Record<string, number>` |  | Property → column width in px (table). |
| `calcs` | `Record<string, "none" \| "countAll" \| "countValues" \| "countUnique" \| "countEmpty" \| "countNotEmpty" \| "percentEmpty" \| "percentNotEmpty" \| "checked" \| "unchecked" \| "percentChecked" \| "sum" \| "average" \| "median" \| "min" \| "max" \| "range" \| "earliest" \| "latest">` |  | Property → footer calculation (table). |
| `dateProperty` | `string` |  | Date property for calendar views. |
| `cardPreview` | `"cover" \| "none"` |  | Card preview for board/gallery. |
| `wrap` | `boolean` |  | Wrap long cell text. |

### `databases.updateProperty`

Rename a property, change its type, number format or select options.

`options` replaces the option list for select / multi-select / status; existing options keep their ids when the name matches. Changing the type converts existing values where possible.

**Permission:** `databases.write` · **Returns:** `DatabaseSchemaInfo` · **Callers:** plugins, assistant · **Assistant modes:** Edit, Creator

| Param | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `databaseId` | `string` | yes | Database id. |
| `property` | `string` | yes | Property name or id ("title" or the title column's name for the title). |
| `name` | `string` |  | New name. |
| `type` | `"text" \| "number" \| "select" \| "multiSelect" \| "status" \| "date" \| "checkbox" \| "url" \| "email" \| "phone" \| "createdTime" \| "lastEdited"` |  | New type. |
| `format` | `"number" \| "commas" \| "percent" \| "dollar" \| "euro" \| "pound" \| "yen"` |  | Number format. |
| `options` | `{ /** Option name. */ name: string; /** Color name. */ color?: "default" \| "gray" \| "brown" \| "orange" \| "yellow" \| "green" \| "blue" \| "purple" \| "pink" \| "red"; /** Status group. */ group?: "todo" \| "inProgress" \| "complete"; }[]` |  | Options (select / multi-select / status). |

## appearance

### `appearance.get`

Get the current customizations (tokens, CSS snippets, component styles).

**Permission:** `appearance` · **Returns:** `Customizations` · **Callers:** plugins, assistant · **Assistant modes:** Ask, Edit, Creator

No parameters.

### `appearance.listTokens`

List the design tokens with their default light and dark values.

**Permission:** `appearance` · **Returns:** `TokenInfo[]` · **Callers:** plugins, assistant · **Assistant modes:** Ask, Edit, Creator

No parameters.

### `appearance.listComponents`

List the app components that can be styled or hidden.

**Permission:** `appearance` · **Returns:** `ComponentInfo[]` · **Callers:** plugins, assistant · **Assistant modes:** Ask, Edit, Creator

No parameters.

### `appearance.setTokens`

Override design tokens (colors, fonts, radii, sizes) for light and/or dark.

Keys are token names without the leading dashes, e.g. { accent: "#2f6fdf", "radius-md": "12px" }. A null value removes an override.

**Permission:** `appearance` · **Returns:** `Customizations` · **Callers:** plugins, assistant · **Assistant modes:** Creator

| Param | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `light` | `Record<string, unknown>` |  | Token → CSS value for the light theme. |
| `dark` | `Record<string, unknown>` |  | Token → CSS value for the dark theme. |
| `both` | `Record<string, unknown>` |  | Token → CSS value for both themes. |
| `layer` | `string` |  | Customization layer to write to. Assistant: defaults to this chat's layer (so the user can switch it off). Plugins: defaults to the plugin's own layer. "base" writes the base look. |

```ts
await app.appearance.setTokens({ both: { accent: "#2f6fdf" }, dark: { bg: "#111418" } });
```

### `appearance.styleComponent`

Style or hide an app component (see appearance.listComponents).

`css` is a list of declarations applied to the component's root, e.g. "border-radius: 16px; background: var(--bg-sunken)". Use `rules` for nested selectors.

**Permission:** `appearance` · **Returns:** `Customizations` · **Callers:** plugins, assistant · **Assistant modes:** Creator

| Param | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `component` | `string` | yes | Component id. |
| `css` | `string` |  | CSS declarations for the component root. "" clears. |
| `rules` | `string` |  | Extra CSS rules; `&` is replaced by the component selector. |
| `hidden` | `boolean` |  | Hide the component. |
| `layer` | `string` |  | Customization layer to write to. Assistant: defaults to this chat's layer (so the user can switch it off). Plugins: defaults to the plugin's own layer. "base" writes the base look. |

### `appearance.addCss`

Add or replace a named CSS snippet applied to the whole app.

**Permission:** `appearance` · **Returns:** `Customizations` · **Callers:** plugins, assistant · **Assistant modes:** Creator

| Param | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `string` | yes | Snippet id (letters, digits, dashes). |
| `css` | `string` | yes | CSS. |
| `label` | `string` |  | Human label. |
| `enabled` | `boolean` |  | Enabled. Default `true`. |
| `layer` | `string` |  | Customization layer to write to. Assistant: defaults to this chat's layer (so the user can switch it off). Plugins: defaults to the plugin's own layer. "base" writes the base look. |

### `appearance.removeCss`

Remove a CSS snippet.

**Permission:** `appearance` · **Returns:** `Customizations` · **Callers:** plugins, assistant · **Assistant modes:** Creator

| Param | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `string` | yes | Snippet id. |
| `layer` | `string` |  | Customization layer to write to. Assistant: defaults to this chat's layer (so the user can switch it off). Plugins: defaults to the plugin's own layer. "base" writes the base look. |

### `appearance.reset`

Reset customizations (all, or only tokens, CSS snippets or component styles).

**Permission:** `appearance` · **Returns:** `Customizations` · **Callers:** plugins, assistant · **Assistant modes:** Creator · **Asks first**

| Param | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `scope` | `"all" \| "tokens" \| "css" \| "components"` |  | What to reset. Default `"all"`. |
| `layer` | `string` |  | Customization layer to write to. Assistant: defaults to this chat's layer (so the user can switch it off). Plugins: defaults to the plugin's own layer. "base" writes the base look. |

### `appearance.listLayers`

List customization layers: switchable bundles of looks, sidebar tabs, status widgets, block and page types.

The assistant writes each chat's changes to its own layer; plugins get one too. Users manage them in Plugins → Created.

**Permission:** `appearance` · **Returns:** `LayerInfo[]` · **Callers:** plugins, assistant · **Assistant modes:** Ask, Edit, Creator

No parameters.

### `appearance.setLayer`

Create a layer or change its name, description or on/off state.

**Permission:** `appearance` · **Returns:** `LayerInfo` · **Callers:** plugins, assistant · **Assistant modes:** Creator

| Param | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `string` | yes | Layer id (lowercase letters, digits, dots, dashes, colons). |
| `name` | `string` |  | Name. |
| `description` | `string` |  | What it changes. |
| `enabled` | `boolean` |  | On or off. |

### `appearance.setLayerPermissions`

Set the App API permissions a layer's HTML views (tabs, widgets, blocks, pages) run with.

By default layer views can read pages, databases and the editor, navigate and notify. Granting write permissions lets their scripts change content.

**Permission:** `appearance` · **Returns:** `LayerInfo` · **Callers:** plugins, assistant · **Assistant modes:** Creator · **Asks first**

| Param | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `string` | yes | Layer id. |
| `permissions` | `string[]` | yes | Permission ids. |

### `appearance.removeLayer`

Delete a layer and everything it adds.

**Permission:** `appearance` · **Returns:** `void` · **Callers:** plugins, assistant · **Assistant modes:** Creator · **Asks first**

| Param | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `string` | yes | Layer id. |

### `ui.ask`

Ask the user a question with choices and/or a free-text answer, and wait for the reply.

For the assistant this renders an inline question card in the chat; for plugins a dialog. Use it to clarify requirements or let the user choose between options instead of guessing. Returns { answer, choices, cancelled }.

**Permission:** `ui.modal` · **Returns:** `AskResult` · **Callers:** plugins, assistant · **Assistant modes:** Ask, Edit, Creator

| Param | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `question` | `string` | yes | The question. |
| `options` | `{ /** Choice label. */ label: string; /** One-line explanation. */ description?: string; }[]` |  | Choices. |
| `multiple` | `boolean` |  | Allow picking several choices. Default `false`. |
| `allowText` | `boolean` |  | Allow a typed answer (always on when there are no options). Default `true`. |
| `placeholder` | `string` |  | Placeholder for the typed answer. |

### `ui.setStatus`

| `title` | `string` |  | Tooltip. |

## web

### `web.search`

Search the web (free, no API key). Returns titles, URLs and snippets.

Uses DuckDuckGo with Wikipedia as a fallback. Fetch a result's URL with web.fetch to read it.

**Permission:** `network` · **Returns:** `WebSearchResult` · **Callers:** plugins, assistant · **Assistant modes:** Ask, Edit, Creator

| Param | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `query` | `string` | yes | Search query. |
| `limit` | `number` |  | Maximum results. Default `8`. |

### `web.fetch`

Fetch a web page and return its readable text, title and links.

**Permission:** `network` · **Returns:** `WebPage` · **Callers:** plugins, assistant · **Assistant modes:** Ask, Edit, Creator

| Param | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `url` | `string` | yes | http(s) URL. |
| `maxChars` | `number` |  | Maximum characters of text. Default `20000`. |

## network

### `network.request`

Make an HTTP request (any method, headers and body) through the app.

Requests to localhost and private networks are blocked. Bodies are text; binary responses come back base64 encoded.

**Permission:** `network` · **Returns:** `HttpResponse` · **Callers:** plugins

| Param | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `url` | `string` | yes | http(s) URL. |
| `method` | `"GET" \| "POST" \| "PUT" \| "PATCH" \| "DELETE" \| "HEAD"` |  | HTTP method. Default `"GET"`. |
| `headers` | `Record<string, string>` |  | Request headers. |
| `body` | `string` |  | Request body. |

## sidebar

### `sidebar.list`

List the right sidebar's tab groups (stacked panels) and every available tab.

**Permission:** none · **Returns:** `SidebarInfo` · **Callers:** plugins, assistant · **Assistant modes:** Ask, Edit, Creator

No parameters.

### `sidebar.setTab`

Add or update a right-sidebar tab with Markdown (+ buttons) or a full HTML view.

Tabs from plugins live while the plugin runs; tabs from the assistant are saved in the chat's customization layer. A new tab is added to the first group unless `group` says otherwise; `split: true` opens it in a new group below.

**Permission:** `ui.panel` · **Returns:** `SidebarTabInfo` · **Callers:** plugins, assistant · **Assistant modes:** Creator

| Param | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `string` | yes | Tab id, unique for this plugin or layer (letters, digits, dots, dashes). |
| `title` | `string` | yes | Tab title. |
| `icon` | `string` |  | Icon: an emoji or a Lucide icon name such as "chart-line". |
| `markdown` | `string` |  | Markdown content. |
| `actions` | `{ /** Action id. */ id: string; /** Label. */ label: string; /** Primary style. */ primary?: boolean; }[]` |  | Buttons under Markdown content; pressing one raises panel:action (plugins). |
| `html` | `string` |  | HTML for a sandboxed view (a fragment or a full document; inline <style> and <script> are fine, no remote scripts). The script gets a global `noteral` (props, setData, call, on, open, notify — see the View API guide). Theme tokens are available as CSS variables, and the kit classes n-btn, n-input, n-card, n-row, n-col, n-grid, n-chip, n-list, n-muted are predefined. |
| `open` | `boolean` |  | Show the sidebar and activate the tab. Default `false`. |
| `split` | `boolean` |  | Open in a new group below the others. Default `false`. |
| `layer` | `string` |  | Customization layer to write to. Assistant: defaults to this chat's layer (so the user can switch it off). Plugins: defaults to the plugin's own layer. "base" writes the base look. |

```ts
await app.sidebar.setTab({ id: "tasks", title: "Tasks", icon: "list-checks", html: "<ul id=list class=n-list></ul><script>noteral.app.databases.queryRows({databaseId:'…'}).then(r=>list.innerHTML=r.map(x=>'<li>'+x.title).join(''))</script>", open: true });
```

### `sidebar.removeTab`

Remove a tab added with sidebar.setTab.

**Permission:** `ui.panel` · **Returns:** `void` · **Callers:** plugins, assistant · **Assistant modes:** Creator

| Param | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `string` | yes | Tab id. |
| `layer` | `string` |  | Customization layer to write to. Assistant: defaults to this chat's layer (so the user can switch it off). Plugins: defaults to the plugin's own layer. "base" writes the base look. |

### `sidebar.openTab`

Show the right sidebar and activate a tab (built-in: outline, backlinks, info, assistant).

**Permission:** `layout` · **Returns:** `void` · **Callers:** plugins, assistant · **Assistant modes:** Ask, Edit, Creator

| Param | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `string` | yes | Tab id or key (see sidebar.list). |
| `split` | `boolean` |  | Move it into a new group below. Default `false`. |

### `sidebar.setLayout`

Arrange the right sidebar: stacked groups of tabs, their order, sizes and active tabs.

Each group is a panel with its own tab strip; groups stack top to bottom and `size` is a relative height. Tabs not listed stay in the last group.

**Permission:** `layout` · **Returns:** `SidebarInfo` · **Callers:** plugins, assistant · **Assistant modes:** Creator

| Param | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `groups` | `{ /** Tab keys in order. */ tabs: string[]; /** Active tab key. */ active?: string; /** Relative height (default 1). */ size?: number; }[]` | yes | Groups, top to bottom (max 6). |
| `width` | `number` |  | Sidebar width in px. |

### `sidebar.moveTab`

Move a tab to another group (or a new group) and position.

**Permission:** `layout` · **Returns:** `SidebarInfo` · **Callers:** plugins, assistant · **Assistant modes:** Creator

| Param | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `string` | yes | Tab key. |
| `group` | `number` | yes | Target group index; -1 = new group at the bottom. |
| `index` | `number` |  | Position in the group. |

Add or update a status bar widget: text with an icon and click command, or a small HTML view.

HTML widgets render in a 22px-high sandboxed frame (`width` px wide) and can call the App API with the owner's permissions.

| Param | Type | Required | Notes |

| `tooltip` | `string` |  | Tooltip. |
| `icon` | `string` |  | Icon: an emoji or a Lucide icon name such as "chart-line". |
| `html` | `string` |  | HTML for a sandboxed view (a fragment or a full document; inline <style> and <script> are fine, no remote scripts). The script gets a global `noteral` (props, setData, call, on, open, notify — see the View API guide). Theme tokens are available as CSS variables, and the kit classes n-btn, n-input, n-card, n-row, n-col, n-grid, n-chip, n-list, n-muted are predefined. |
| `width` | `number` |  | Width in px for HTML widgets. Default `120`. |
| `side` | `"left" \| "right"` |  | Side. Default `"right"`. |
| `order` | `number` |  | Order (lower first). Default `0`. |
| `command` | `string` |  | Command id to run on click (see commands.list). |
| `layer` | `string` |  | Customization layer to write to. Assistant: defaults to this chat's layer (so the user can switch it off). Plugins: defaults to the plugin's own layer. "base" writes the base look. |

## blocks

### `blocks.registerType`

Register a custom editor block type rendered by an HTML view; it appears in the slash menu.

Each block stores JSON data in the page. In the view, read it from `noteral.props.data` and save changes with `noteral.setData(next)`; `noteral.props.editable` says whether the page can be edited. Keep `type` stable: documents reference it.

**Permission:** `blocks` · **Returns:** `BlockTypeInfo` · **Callers:** plugins, assistant · **Assistant modes:** Creator

| Param | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `type` | `string` | yes | Type id, e.g. "kanban-mini" (lowercase letters, digits, dots, dashes). |
| `title` | `string` | yes | Name in the slash menu. |
| `description` | `string` |  | Slash menu hint. |
| `icon` | `string` |  | Icon: an emoji or a Lucide icon name such as "chart-line". |
| `keywords` | `string[]` |  | Extra search words. |
| `html` | `string` | yes | HTML for a sandboxed view (a fragment or a full document; inline <style> and <script> are fine, no remote scripts). The script gets a global `noteral` (props, setData, call, on, open, notify — see the View API guide). Theme tokens are available as CSS variables, and the kit classes n-btn, n-input, n-card, n-row, n-col, n-grid, n-chip, n-list, n-muted are predefined. |
| `defaultData` | `unknown` |  | Data for new blocks. |
| `height` | `number` |  | Initial height in px (the view auto-resizes). Default `120`. |
| `layer` | `string` |  | Customization layer to write to. Assistant: defaults to this chat's layer (so the user can switch it off). Plugins: defaults to the plugin's own layer. "base" writes the base look. |

```ts
await app.blocks.registerType({ type: "counter", title: "Counter", icon: "plus", defaultData: { n: 0 }, html: "<button class=n-btn id=b></button><script>const r=()=>b.textContent='Clicked '+noteral.props.data.n;r();noteral.onProps(r);b.onclick=()=>noteral.setData({n:noteral.props.data.n+1})</script>" });
```

### `blocks.unregisterType`

Remove a custom block type (existing blocks show a placeholder).

**Permission:** `blocks` · **Returns:** `void` · **Callers:** plugins, assistant · **Assistant modes:** Creator

| Param | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `type` | `string` | yes | Type id. |
| `layer` | `string` |  | Customization layer to write to. Assistant: defaults to this chat's layer (so the user can switch it off). Plugins: defaults to the plugin's own layer. "base" writes the base look. |

### `blocks.listTypes`

List custom block types.

**Permission:** none · **Returns:** `BlockTypeInfo[]` · **Callers:** plugins, assistant · **Assistant modes:** Ask, Edit, Creator

No parameters.

### `blocks.insert`

Insert a custom block into the open page.

**Permission:** `editor.write` · **Returns:** `{ blockId: string }` · **Callers:** plugins, assistant · **Assistant modes:** Edit, Creator

| Param | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `type` | `string` | yes | Custom block type. |
| `data` | `unknown` |  | Block data (defaults to the type's defaultData). |
| `after` | `string` |  | Insert after this block id (default: end of page). |

### `blocks.setData`

Replace the data of a custom block in the open page.

**Permission:** `editor.write` · **Returns:** `void` · **Callers:** plugins, assistant · **Assistant modes:** Edit, Creator

| Param | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `blockId` | `string` | yes | Block id. |
| `data` | `unknown` | yes | New data. |

## nodes

### `nodes.registerType`

Register a custom page type for the page tree, opened in a full-page HTML view.

Items of this type are created with nodes.create or from the tree's New menu. The view gets `noteral.props` = { pageId, title, data, editable } and saves with `noteral.setData(next)`. Items can have children like folders.

**Permission:** `nodes` · **Returns:** `NodeTypeInfo` · **Callers:** plugins, assistant · **Assistant modes:** Creator

| Param | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `type` | `string` | yes | Type id (lowercase letters, digits, dots, dashes). |
| `title` | `string` | yes | Type name, e.g. "Kanban board". |
| `description` | `string` |  | Shown in the New menu. |
| `icon` | `string` |  | Icon: an emoji or a Lucide icon name such as "chart-line". |
| `html` | `string` | yes | HTML for a sandboxed view (a fragment or a full document; inline <style> and <script> are fine, no remote scripts). The script gets a global `noteral` (props, setData, call, on, open, notify — see the View API guide). Theme tokens are available as CSS variables, and the kit classes n-btn, n-input, n-card, n-row, n-col, n-grid, n-chip, n-list, n-muted are predefined. |
| `defaultData` | `unknown` |  | Data for new items. |
| `layer` | `string` |  | Customization layer to write to. Assistant: defaults to this chat's layer (so the user can switch it off). Plugins: defaults to the plugin's own layer. "base" writes the base look. |

### `nodes.unregisterType`

### `nodes.create`

Create an item of a custom page type in the tree.

| Param | Type | Required | Notes |

## home

### `home.listViews`

List Home views (built-in templates and custom views).

**Permission:** none · **Returns:** `HomeViewSummary[]` · **Callers:** plugins, assistant · **Assistant modes:** Ask, Edit, Creator

No parameters.

### `home.widgetTypes`

List Home widget types with their default sizes.

**Permission:** none · **Returns:** `HomeWidgetTypeInfo[]` · **Callers:** plugins, assistant · **Assistant modes:** Ask, Edit, Creator

No parameters.

### `home.getView`

Get a custom Home view with all widgets and settings.

**Permission:** none · **Returns:** `HomeViewInfo` · **Callers:** plugins, assistant · **Assistant modes:** Ask, Edit, Creator

| Param | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `viewId` | `string` | yes | Custom view id. |

### `home.createView`

Create a custom Home view (empty, from a template layout, or a copy).

**Permission:** `home` · **Returns:** `HomeViewInfo` · **Callers:** plugins, assistant · **Assistant modes:** Creator

| Param | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | `string` |  | View name. |
| `from` | `string` |  | Copy this custom view id instead of starting from the default layout. |
| `empty` | `boolean` |  | Start with no widgets. |
| `open` | `boolean` |  | Open it in the active Home tab. Default `true`. |

### `home.updateView`

Change a custom view's settings: name, width, gap, card style, radius, shadow, font, accent, CSS.

`css` is scoped to the view: `&` is the Home view root, and `.home-card` / `[data-widget-type=…]` target cards.

**Permission:** `home` · **Returns:** `HomeViewInfo` · **Callers:** plugins, assistant · **Assistant modes:** Creator

| Param | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `viewId` | `string` | yes | Custom view id. |
| `name` | `string` |  | Name. |
| `title` | `string` |  | Greeting headline override. |
| `width` | `"narrow" \| "wide" \| "full"` |  | Content width. |
| `gap` | `"tight" \| "normal" \| "roomy"` |  | Spacing. |
| `cards` | `"glass" \| "solid" \| "outline" \| "flat"` |  | Default card style. |
| `radius` | `number` |  | Card radius px. |
| `shadow` | `"none" \| "soft" \| "lifted"` |  | Card shadow. |
| `font` | `"serif" \| "sans" \| "mono"` |  | Font. |
| `valign` | `"top" \| "center"` |  | Vertical alignment. |
| `accent` | `string` |  | Accent #rrggbb ("" resets). |
| `css` | `string` |  | Custom CSS for the view. |

### `home.removeView`

Delete a custom Home view.

**Permission:** `home` · **Returns:** `void` · **Callers:** plugins, assistant · **Assistant modes:** Creator · **Asks first**

| Param | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `viewId` | `string` | yes | Custom view id. |

### `home.setDefault`

Make a view (template id or custom view id) the default for new Home tabs.

**Permission:** `home` · **Returns:** `void` · **Callers:** plugins, assistant · **Assistant modes:** Creator

| Param | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `viewId` | `string` | yes | View id. |

### `home.open`

Open a Home view (template id or custom view id) in a Home tab.

**Permission:** `navigation` · **Returns:** `void` · **Callers:** plugins, assistant · **Assistant modes:** Ask, Edit, Creator

| Param | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `viewId` | `string` | yes | View id. |

### `home.setBackground`

Set a Home view's background: a preset, a color, a gradient or an animated wallpaper.

**Permission:** `home` · **Returns:** `void` · **Callers:** plugins, assistant · **Assistant modes:** Creator

| Param | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `viewId` | `string` | yes | View id (template or custom). |
| `background` | `string` | yes | Preset id (see home.listViews → backgrounds), "custom-color" or "custom-gradient". |
| `color` | `string` |  | #rrggbb for custom-color. |
| `gradient` | `{ /** #rrggbb */ from: string; /** #rrggbb */ to: string; /** Degrees. */ angle?: number; /** Kind. */ kind?: "linear" \| "radial"; }` |  |  |

### `home.addWidget`

Add a widget to a custom Home view; type "html" is a fully custom widget (HTML/CSS/JS).

Without x/y the widget goes into the first free spot. HTML widgets get `noteral.props` = { data, widgetId, viewId } and can persist with `noteral.setData(next)`.

**Permission:** `home` · **Returns:** `HomeWidgetInfo` · **Callers:** plugins, assistant · **Assistant modes:** Creator

| Param | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `viewId` | `string` | yes | Custom view id. |
| `type` | `string` | yes | Widget type (see home.widgetTypes). |
| `x` | `number` |  | Column (0-23). |
| `y` | `number` |  | Row (10px rows). |
| `w` | `number` |  | Width in columns (1-24). |
| `h` | `number` |  | Height in rows (1 row = 10px). |
| `title` | `string` |  | Card title. |
| `hideTitle` | `boolean` |  | Hide the title. |
| `style` | `"default" \| "glass" \| "solid" \| "outline" \| "flat"` |  | Card style. |
| `tint` | `string` |  | Accent color (#rrggbb). |
| `variant` | `string` |  | Widget-specific variant (e.g. clock: digital\|analog\|minimal). |
| `text` | `string` |  | Text / Markdown for note, text and prompt widgets. |
| `limit` | `number` |  | Items to show. |
| `pageId` | `string` |  | Page/folder/database the widget points at. |
| `pageIds` | `string[]` |  | Pages for links/gallery widgets. |
| `url` | `string` |  | Image URL or link. |
| `date` | `string` |  | ISO date for countdowns. |
| `html` | `string` |  | HTML for a sandboxed view (a fragment or a full document; inline <style> and <script> are fine, no remote scripts). The script gets a global `noteral` (props, setData, call, on, open, notify — see the View API guide). Theme tokens are available as CSS variables, and the kit classes n-btn, n-input, n-card, n-row, n-col, n-grid, n-chip, n-list, n-muted are predefined. |
| `css` | `string` |  | Extra CSS for this widget's card (`&` = the card). |
| `data` | `unknown` |  | Free-form data for html widgets (noteral.props.data). |

```ts
await app.home.addWidget({ viewId, type: "html", title: "Weather", w: 8, h: 14, html: "<div class=n-card>☀️ 21°</div>" });
```

### `home.updateWidget`

Change a Home widget (position, size, style, content).

**Permission:** `home` · **Returns:** `HomeWidgetInfo` · **Callers:** plugins, assistant · **Assistant modes:** Creator

| Param | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `viewId` | `string` | yes | Custom view id. |
| `widgetId` | `string` | yes | Widget id. |
| `type` | `string` |  | Widget type (see home.widgetTypes). "html" is a fully custom widget. |
| `x` | `number` |  | Column (0-23). |
| `y` | `number` |  | Row (10px rows). |
| `w` | `number` |  | Width in columns (1-24). |
| `h` | `number` |  | Height in rows (1 row = 10px). |
| `title` | `string` |  | Card title. |
| `hideTitle` | `boolean` |  | Hide the title. |
| `style` | `"default" \| "glass" \| "solid" \| "outline" \| "flat"` |  | Card style. |
| `tint` | `string` |  | Accent color (#rrggbb). |
| `variant` | `string` |  | Widget-specific variant (e.g. clock: digital\|analog\|minimal). |
| `text` | `string` |  | Text / Markdown for note, text and prompt widgets. |
| `limit` | `number` |  | Items to show. |
| `pageId` | `string` |  | Page/folder/database the widget points at. |
| `pageIds` | `string[]` |  | Pages for links/gallery widgets. |
| `url` | `string` |  | Image URL or link. |
| `date` | `string` |  | ISO date for countdowns. |
| `html` | `string` |  | HTML for a sandboxed view (a fragment or a full document; inline <style> and <script> are fine, no remote scripts). The script gets a global `noteral` (props, setData, call, on, open, notify — see the View API guide). Theme tokens are available as CSS variables, and the kit classes n-btn, n-input, n-card, n-row, n-col, n-grid, n-chip, n-list, n-muted are predefined. |
| `css` | `string` |  | Extra CSS for this widget's card (`&` = the card). |
| `data` | `unknown` |  | Free-form data for html widgets (noteral.props.data). |

### `home.removeWidget`

Remove a Home widget.

**Permission:** `home` · **Returns:** `void` · **Callers:** plugins, assistant · **Assistant modes:** Creator

| Param | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `viewId` | `string` | yes | Custom view id. |
| `widgetId` | `string` | yes | Widget id. |

## views

### `views.post`

Send a message to the plugin's HTML views (tabs, widgets, blocks, pages); they receive it with noteral.onMessage.

**Permission:** none · **Returns:** `{ delivered: number }` · **Callers:** plugins

| Param | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | `string` | yes | Message name. |
| `payload` | `unknown` |  | JSON payload. |
| `view` | `string` |  | Only this view key (from the view:message event). |

## plugins

### `plugins.list`

List installed plugins.

**Permission:** none · **Returns:** `PluginInfo[]` · **Callers:** assistant · **Assistant modes:** Ask, Edit, Creator

No parameters.

### `plugins.getSource`

Read an installed plugin's manifest, code and styles.

**Permission:** none · **Returns:** `PluginSourceInfo` · **Callers:** assistant · **Assistant modes:** Creator

| Param | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `string` | yes | Plugin id. |

### `plugins.create`

Install (or update) a plugin written by the assistant. The user reviews the code and permissions first.

code is plain JavaScript run in a sandbox. It must call Noteral.register(class extends Noteral.Plugin { async onload() {…} onunload() {…} }). Use this.app.<namespace>.<method>(params) for every App API method (e.g. this.app.sidebar.setTab, this.app.statusBar.setWidget, this.app.blocks.registerType, this.app.nodes.registerType, this.app.home.addWidget), this.addCommand({ id, title, run }), this.setStatus(itemId, text), this.setPanel(panelId, { title, markdown, actions }), this.onPanelAction(panelId, fn), this.onViewMessage(fn), this.registerEvent(eventName, fn), this.addStyles(css), this.loadData() / this.saveData(patch). The plugin is test-run first (see plugins.test) and, after installing, its start-up is checked: the result's `health` reports errors so you can fix and reinstall.

**Permission:** none · **Returns:** `PluginInstallResult` · **Callers:** assistant · **Assistant modes:** Creator · **Asks first**

| Param | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `manifest` | `{ /** Reverse-DNS id, e.g. com.assistant.word-goal. */ id: string; /** Name. */ name: string; /** Semver, e.g. 1.0.0. */ version: string; /** What it does. */ description: string; /** Permissions the code needs. */ permissions?: string[]; /** Commands it adds. */ commands?: { /** Command id (lowercase, dashes). */ id: string; /** Title. */ title: string; }[]; /** Status bar items. */ statusItems?: { /** Item id. */ id: string; /** Label. */ label: string; }[]; /** Sidebar panels. */ panels?: { /** Panel id. */ id: string; /** Title. */ title: string; }[]; }` | yes |  |
| `code` | `string` | yes | Plugin JavaScript. |
| `styles` | `string` |  | Optional CSS (needs ui.styles). |
| `skipTest` | `boolean` |  | Install even if the test run reports errors. Default `false`. |

### `plugins.test`

Run plugin code in a throw-away sandbox without installing it, and report errors, logs, commands and UI it registered.

Write calls (except UI registration) are skipped during the test. Always test before plugins.create and fix every reported error.

**Permission:** none · **Returns:** `PluginTestResult` · **Callers:** assistant · **Assistant modes:** Ask, Edit, Creator

| Param | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `manifest` | `{ /** Plugin id. */ id: string; /** Name. */ name: string; /** Version. */ version?: string; /** Permissions. */ permissions?: string[]; }` | yes |  |
| `code` | `string` | yes | Plugin JavaScript. |
| `styles` | `string` |  | CSS. |
| `waitMs` | `number` |  | How long to watch it (ms). Default `1500`. |

### `plugins.logs`

Read an installed plugin's recent errors, warnings and console output.

**Permission:** none · **Returns:** `LogEntryInfo[]` · **Callers:** assistant · **Assistant modes:** Ask, Edit, Creator

| Param | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `string` | yes | Plugin id. |
| `limit` | `number` |  | Entries. Default `50`. |

### `plugins.uninstall`

Uninstall a plugin.

**Permission:** none · **Returns:** `void` · **Callers:** assistant · **Assistant modes:** Creator · **Asks first**

| Param | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `string` | yes | Plugin id. |

### `plugins.setEnabled`

Enable or disable an installed plugin.

**Permission:** none · **Returns:** `void` · **Callers:** assistant · **Assistant modes:** Creator

| Param | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `string` | yes | Plugin id. |
| `enabled` | `boolean` | yes | Enabled. |

## Events

Subscribe with `this.registerEvent(name, handler)`. Events are only computed while someone listens.

| Event | Payload | Permission | When |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `document:changed` | `EditorSnapshot` | `editor.read` | The open page changed (debounced). Payload is the editor snapshot. |
| `page:opened` | `ActivePage \| null` | none | A different page (or Home) became active. |
| `theme:changed` | `{ theme: "light" \| "dark" }` | none | Light/dark theme changed. |
| `workspace:opened` | `WorkspaceInfo` | none | A workspace was opened. |
| `pages:changed` | `{ count: number }` | `pages.read` | Pages were created, renamed, moved or trashed. |
| `panel:action` | `{ panelId: string; actionId: string }` | `ui.panel` | A button in one of the plugin's panels or Markdown tabs was pressed. |
| `view:message` | `{ view: string; name: string; payload: unknown }` | none | One of the plugin's HTML views called noteral.post(name, payload). |

## Permissions

| Permission | Risk | Grants |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `editor.read` | low | **Read the open page.** Read the text, blocks and selection of the page you are editing. |
| `editor.write` | medium | **Edit the open page.** Insert, change and remove blocks in the page you are editing. |
| `pages.read` | medium | **Read pages.** List pages and read the content of any page in the workspace. |
| `pages.write` | high | **Change pages.** Create, rename, move, rewrite and trash pages. |
| `databases.read` | medium | **Read databases.** Read database schemas and rows. |
| `databases.write` | high | **Change databases.** Create databases, add properties and add or edit rows. |
| `navigation` | low | **Navigate.** Open pages, go back and forward, open Home. |
| `search.read` | medium | **Search.** Run full-text searches across the workspace. |
| `ui.status` | low | **Status bar.** Show text and widgets in the status bar. |
| `ui.notify` | low | **Notifications.** Show toast notifications. |
| `ui.panel` | low | **Sidebar tabs.** Add tabs to the right sidebar. |
| `ui.modal` | low | **Dialogs.** Ask you to confirm, type an answer or pick from a list. |
| `ui.styles` | medium | **Plugin styles.** Add CSS to the app (for the plugin's own look). |
| `settings.read` | low | **Read its settings.** Read the plugin's own saved settings. |
| `settings.write` | low | **Save its settings.** Save the plugin's own settings. |
| `assets.read` | low | **Read files.** Read images and files attached to pages. |
| `assets.write` | low | **Import files.** Ask you to pick an image or file and import it. |
| `workspaces.read` | low | **See workspaces.** List workspaces and see which one is open. |
| `workspaces.write` | high | **Manage workspaces.** Create, rename and switch workspaces. |
| `layout` | low | **Layout.** Split panes, arrange sidebar tab groups, show or hide sidebars and resize panels. |
| `appearance` | medium | **Appearance.** Change colors, fonts and component styles across the app. |
| `preferences` | medium | **Preferences.** Read and change app preferences such as theme and font size. |
| `commands.execute` | high | **Run commands.** Run any command from the command palette. |
| `clipboard` | medium | **Clipboard.** Read and write the clipboard. |
| `network` | high | **Internet access.** Make web requests, search the web and fetch pages. |
| `blocks` | low | **Custom blocks.** Add new kinds of blocks to the editor (rendered in a sandbox). |
| `nodes` | low | **Custom page types.** Add new kinds of items to the page tree (rendered in a sandbox). |
| `home` | medium | **Home.** Create, change and remove Home views and widgets. |

## Types

Return types, as shipped in `@noteral/sdk` (`sdk/src/types.ts`).

```ts
export interface AppInfo {
  appName: string;
  appVersion: string;
  sdkVersion: string;
  platform: string;
  theme: "light" | "dark";
  workspaceId: string | null;
}

export interface ActivePage {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  kind: "page" | "folder" | "database" | "row" | "custom";
  paneId: string;
  /** True when the page is open in a live editor (editor.* methods work on it). */
  editable: boolean;
}

export interface BlockSummary {
  id: string;
  type: string;
  text: string;
  props?: Record<string, unknown>;
  children?: BlockSummary[];
}

export interface EditorSelection {
  text: string;
  blockIds: string[];
  cursorBlockId: string;
}

export interface OutlineItem {
  id: string;
  text: string;
  level: number;
}

export interface EditorSnapshot {
  pageId: string;
  title: string;
  wordCount: number;
  blockCount: number;
  text: string;
  outline: OutlineItem[];
}

export interface PageInfo {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  icon: string;
  cover: string;
  kind: "page" | "folder" | "database" | "row" | "custom";
  /** Custom node type id, for kind "custom" (see nodes.listTypes). */
  nodeType?: string;
  parentId: string;
  /** For rows: the database they belong to. */
  databaseId?: string;
  createdAt: string;
  updatedAt: string;
  deleted?: boolean;
}

export interface PageContent {
  page: PageInfo;
  format: "markdown" | "text";
  content: string;
  /** Child pages (and database rows) directly under this page. */
  children: PageInfo[];
}

export interface DatabaseInfo {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  parentId: string;
  rowCount: number;
  properties: string[];
}

export interface DatabasePropertyInfo {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  type: string;
  options?: { id: string; name: string; color: string }[];
}

export interface DatabaseSchemaInfo {
  databaseId: string;
  title: string;
  titleName: string;
  properties: DatabasePropertyInfo[];
  views: { id: string; name: string; type: string }[];
}

export interface DatabaseViewInfo {
  databaseId: string;
  id: string;
  name: string;
  type: "table" | "board" | "gallery" | "list" | "calendar";
  filters: { id: string; property: string; op: string; value?: unknown }[];
  filterMode: "and" | "or";
  sorts: { property: string; direction: "asc" | "desc" }[];
  /** Visible properties, in order (the title column first). */
  visible: string[];
  hidden: string[];
  groupBy?: string;
  hiddenGroups?: string[];
  dateProperty?: string;
  cardPreview?: "cover" | "none";
  wrap?: boolean;
  widths?: Record<string, number>;
  calcs?: Record<string, string>;
}

export interface DatabaseRowInfo {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  /** Values keyed by property name; select options are returned by name. */
  values: Record<string, unknown>;
  updatedAt: string;
}

export interface WorkspaceInfo {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  pageCount: number;
  current: boolean;
}

export interface TabInfo {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  kind: "page" | "home";
  paneId: string;
  active: boolean;
}

export interface PaneInfo {
  id: string;
  tabs: string[];
  activeTabId: string;
  focused: boolean;
  maximized: boolean;
}

export interface LayoutInfo {
  panes: PaneInfo[];
  /** Nested split tree: { type: "pane", id } | { type: "split", dir, sizes, children }. */
  tree: unknown;
  leftOpen: boolean;
  rightOpen: boolean;
  railOpen: boolean;
  leftWidth: number;
  rightWidth: number;
  leftTab: string;
  rightTab: string;
}

export interface SearchHitInfo {
  pageId: string;
  title: string;
  snippet: string;
  updatedAt: string;
}

export interface Preferences {
  theme: "light" | "dark" | "system";
  editorFont: "serif" | "sans";
  fontSize: number;
  lineHeight: number;
  pageWidth: number;
  fullWidth: boolean;
  autosaveDelay: number;
  spellcheck: boolean;
  reduceMotion: boolean;
  showStats: boolean;
}

export interface CssSnippet {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  css: string;
  enabled: boolean;
}

export interface ComponentStyle {
  css?: string;
  rules?: string;
  hidden?: boolean;
}

export interface Look {
  tokens: { light: Record<string, string>; dark: Record<string, string> };
  components: Record<string, ComponentStyle>;
  css: CssSnippet[];
}

/** The base look plus every layer. */
export interface Customizations extends Look {
  version: 2;
  layers: LayerInfo[];
  sidebar?: { groups: { id: string; tabs: string[]; active: string; size: number }[] };
}

/** A switchable bundle of customizations (see appearance.listLayers). */
export interface LayerInfo extends Look {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  description?: string;
  source: "assistant" | "user" | "plugin";
  enabled: boolean;
  createdAt: number;
  updatedAt: number;
  permissions: string[];
  chatId?: string;
  pluginId?: string;
  sidebarTabs: SidebarTabDefinition[];
  statusWidgets: StatusWidgetDefinition[];
  blockTypes: BlockTypeDefinition[];
  nodeTypes: NodeTypeDefinition[];
}

export interface TokenInfo {
  name: string;
  group: "color" | "font" | "shape" | "layout";
  description: string;
  light: string;
  dark: string;
}

export interface ComponentInfo {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  selector: string;
  description: string;
}

export interface CommandInfo {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  category: string;
  description?: string;
  shortcut?: string;
}

export interface WebSearchResult {
  query: string;
  engine: string;
  results: { title: string; url: string; snippet: string }[];
}

export interface WebPage {
  url: string;
  finalUrl: string;
  title: string;
  contentType: string;
  /** Readable text (Markdown-ish) extracted from the page. */
  content: string;
  truncated: boolean;
  links?: { text: string; url: string }[];
}

export interface HttpResponse {
  status: number;
  statusText: string;
  headers: Record<string, string>;
  /** Body as text, or base64 when `encoding` is "base64". */
  body: string;
  encoding: "text" | "base64";
  url: string;
}

export interface PluginInfo {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  version: string;
  author: string;
  description: string;
  enabled: boolean;
  source: string;
  permissions: string[];
  problem?: string;
}

export interface PluginSourceInfo {
  manifest: Record<string, unknown>;
  code: string;
  styles: string;
}

export interface PanelAction {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  primary?: boolean;
}

/** manifest.json — see docs/plugins/manifest.md. */
export interface PluginManifest {
  /** Reverse-domain id, e.g. "com.example.word-goal". Never changes between versions. */
  id: string;
  name: string;
  /** Semver, e.g. "1.2.0". Must match the GitHub release tag (with or without "v"). */
  version: string;
  /** SDK the plugin was built against, e.g. "2.0.0". */
  sdkVersion: string;
  /** Oldest Noteral version the plugin works with. */
  minAppVersion?: string;
  description?: string;
  author?: string;
  authorUrl?: string;
  /** "owner/name" of the GitHub repository that publishes releases. */
  repo?: string;
  /** Bundled script, usually "main.js". */
  entry: string;
  permissions: string[];
  contributes?: {
    commands?: Array<{ id: string; title: string; description?: string; keywords?: string }>;
    statusItems?: Array<{ id: string; label: string }>;
    panels?: Array<{ id: string; title: string }>;
  };
}

export interface StatusOptions {
  /** Tooltip shown on hover. */
  title?: string;
}

/** Content of a sidebar tab or similar surface: Markdown with buttons, or an HTML view. */
export interface ViewContent {
  markdown?: string;
  actions?: PanelAction[];
  html?: string;
}

export interface SidebarTabDefinition {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  icon?: string;
  view: ViewContent;
}

export interface StatusWidgetDefinition {
  id: string;
  text?: string;
  tooltip?: string;
  icon?: string;
  html?: string;
  width?: number;
  side: "left" | "right";
  order: number;
  command?: string;
}

export interface BlockTypeDefinition {
  type: string;
  title: string;
  description?: string;
  icon?: string;
  keywords?: string[];
  html: string;
  defaultData?: unknown;
  height?: number;
}

export interface NodeTypeDefinition {
  type: string;
  title: string;
  description?: string;
  icon?: string;
  html: string;
  defaultData?: unknown;
}

export interface ContributionOwnerInfo {
  kind: "plugin" | "layer";
  id: string;
  name: string;
}

export interface SidebarTabInfo {
  /** Key used by sidebar.openTab / setLayout: built-in id or "<owner kind>:<owner id>:<tab id>". */
  key: string;
  id: string;
  title: string;
  icon?: string;
  builtin: boolean;
  owner?: ContributionOwnerInfo;
  kind: "builtin" | "markdown" | "html";
}

export interface SidebarInfo {
  open: boolean;
  width: number;
  groups: { tabs: string[]; active: string; size: number }[];
  tabs: SidebarTabInfo[];
}

export interface StatusWidgetInfo {
  key: string;
  id: string;
  side: "left" | "right";
  order: number;
  builtin: boolean;
  text?: string;
  kind: "builtin" | "text" | "html";
  owner?: ContributionOwnerInfo;
}

export interface BlockTypeInfo {
  type: string;
  title: string;
  description?: string;
  icon?: string;
  owner: ContributionOwnerInfo;
}

export interface NodeTypeInfo {
  type: string;
  title: string;
  description?: string;
  icon?: string;
  owner: ContributionOwnerInfo;
}

export interface HomeViewSummary {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  kind: "template" | "custom";
  isDefault: boolean;
  widgets?: number;
  background: string;
}

export interface HomeWidgetInfo {
  id: string;
  type: string;
  x: number;
  y: number;
  w: number;
  h: number;
  title?: string;
  [key: string]: unknown;
}

export interface HomeViewInfo {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  title: string;
  width: "narrow" | "wide" | "full";
  gap: "tight" | "normal" | "roomy";
  cards: "glass" | "solid" | "outline" | "flat";
  radius: number;
  shadow: "none" | "soft" | "lifted";
  font: "serif" | "sans" | "mono";
  valign: "top" | "center";
  accent?: string;
  css?: string;
  widgets: HomeWidgetInfo[];
  /** Background presets that home.setBackground accepts. */
  backgrounds: string[];
}

export interface HomeWidgetTypeInfo {
  type: string;
  label: string;
  description: string;
  w: number;
  h: number;
}

export interface AskResult {
  /** The typed answer, or the chosen labels joined with ", ". */
  answer: string;
  choices: string[];
  cancelled: boolean;
}

export interface LogEntryInfo {
  at: number;
  level: "info" | "warn" | "error";
  message: string;
}

export interface PluginTestResult {
  ok: boolean;
  status: "ready" | "failed" | "timeout";
  error?: string;
  logs: { level: string; message: string }[];
  commands: string[];
  contributions: { sidebarTabs: string[]; statusWidgets: string[]; blockTypes: string[]; nodeTypes: string[]; panels: string[]; statusItems: string[] };
  /** App API methods the code called. */
  calls: string[];
  /** Write calls that were skipped during the test. */
  skipped: string[];
}

export interface PluginInstallResult extends PluginInfo {
  test?: PluginTestResult;
  health: { status: "ready" | "failed" | "starting" | "stopped"; error?: string; logs: { level: string; message: string }[] };
}
```
